episodes.title: Dead Man's Hand
episodes.summary: When a close friend of hers meets an untimely end, Charlie Cale, a casino cocktail waitress with an uncanny knack for identifying lies, is determined to unravel these mysterious events -- even if it endangers her own life.

episodes.title: The Night Shift
episodes.summary: Wounded and on the run, Charlie is forced to make a pit stop in desolate New Mexico, where she tries to clear the name of a trucker framed for the murder of a local.

episodes.title: The Stall
episodes.summary: Charlie takes a job at a family-run Texas BBQ joint and must use her perception skills to sniff out the truth behind a shocking death.

episodes.title: Rest in Metal
episodes.summary: Charlie goes on tour with has-been metal band Doxxxology, a motley crew of dejected rockers who've spent decades trying to write a new hit; Charlie suspects foul play when one musician winds up dead.

episodes.title: Time of the Monkey
episodes.summary: Charlie suspects her new besties at the retirement home played a role in another senior's death.

episodes.title: Exit Stage Death
episodes.summary: When a dinner theater performance results in a tragic death, Charlie suspects foul play.

episodes.title: The Future of the Sport
episodes.summary: While working at a go-kart complex, Charlie becomes involved in a bitter feud between an aging race car driver and a hotheaded young upstart, whose rivalry has explosive consequences.

episodes.title: The Orpheus Syndrome
episodes.summary: A special effects artist unearths a past project to find closure from the guilt of a fatal on-set accident; when old demons resurface, Charlie is left to unravel a new deadly plot.

episodes.title: Escape from Shit Mountain
episodes.summary: Charlie finds herself stranded in a motel during a blizzard; in order to survive the night, Charlie must decipher the deadly tension between her questionable companions.

episodes.title: The Hook
episodes.summary: Charlie faces her greatest challenge yet when she is caught in the crossfire of a deadly power play that puts her in the sights of two ruthless crime syndicates and the FBI.

episodes.title: The Game Is a Foot
episodes.summary: Charlie Cale takes on an investigation into a seemingly innocent death in a friend's family.

episodes.title: Last Looks
episodes.summary: When her new friend disappears from a film set, Charlie must unearth clues at the family-run funeral home that served as the production's most recent location.

episodes.title: Whack-A-Mole
episodes.summary: Caught between the mob and the FBI, Charlie must cobble together the truth of who is working for whom, using her talents to find a rat, or possibly a mole.

episodes.title: The Taste of Human Blood
episodes.summary: Adjusting to a new way of life, Charlie teams up with an animal liberation operation to rescue a gentle soul unjustly framed for murder at a police awards ceremony.

episodes.title: Hometown Hero
episodes.summary: While working as a ball girl for a bad minor league team, Charlie suspects foul play in the death of one of the players.

episodes.title: Sloppy Joseph
episodes.summary: Charlie gets caught up in the politics of an elementary school classroom when a harmless talent show performance is upstaged by a student's diabolical plot involving the class pet.

episodes.title: One Last Job
episodes.summary: Charlie has a classic rom-com meet-cute with a big box store manager, but when her new beau is accused of masterminding the heist of the store's Black Friday profits, it's up to her to figure out what happened.

episodes.title: The Sleazy Georgian
episodes.summary: Charlie charms a group of old-school con artists and is excited to learn the ins and outs of their modest operation, but it's all fun and games until a con goes sideways.

episodes.title: A New Lease On Death
episodes.summary: Trying to turn over a new leaf as a city dweller, Charlie has her housewarming put in jeopardy when a neighbor dies in a suspicious accident.

episodes.title: The Big Pump
episodes.summary: Charlie is convinced by her new gym buddy that there's more to the tragic death of a local lifter than poor technique.

episodes.title: Day of the Iguana
episodes.summary: Abandoning her serving job at a fancy wedding, Charlie vows to clear the name of a friend caught in a compromising position.

episodes.title: The End of the Road
episodes.summary: Charlie questions everything she believes in as she races to warn the target of a notorious killer before it's too late.
